name: paperclip
description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
one_liner: A dashboard that lets a non-technical manager see, start, and check on a whole team of AI agents at once, instead of everyone juggling their own chat windows.
buyer: An operations manager at a small agency who has five different employees each running their own AI coding or research agents and has no visibility into what any of them are doing.
business_use_cases: A digital agency gives its account managers a shared board of client-work agents so a manager can see 'website redesign for Client X' is 80% done without pinging the developer.
A remote ops team runs recurring AI agents (invoice chasing, lead research) and uses the dashboard as the single place to check they actually ran today.
A consultancy demos 'AI-powered delivery' to a prospective client by showing them the live agent board instead of a slide deck.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version for teams who don't want to self-host it.
Sell setup/integration services wiring a client's existing AI agents into the dashboard.

steal_this: Stand up a self-hosted instance for one local agency this weekend and charge them a flat fee to connect their existing 2-3 AI tools into it as a 'command center'.
